title: Hierarchical Reward Design from Language: Enhancing Alignment of Agent Behavior with Human Specifications
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of AI alignment by translating natural language behavioral specifications into hierarchical reward functions. While alignment is a component of AI ethics, this paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks; it uses specifications like 'avoid yellow zones' or 'alternate items' as technical tasks for reinforcement learning.
